coast.description: Applied to WATER (1). Key: land neighbours, edges N E S W and the diagonal neighbours NE SE SW NW whose two adjacent sides are water.

path.description: Applied to PATH (57). Key: neighbouring path tiles N E S W.

fog.description: Fog layer with the levels 1 (light), 2 (medium) and 3 (dense). Areas use the 3 x 3 frame, cells without a neighbour on two opposite sides use one of the single clouds.

VOLCANO.description: Volcano with smoke, sparks and lava

SHARK_SWIMMING.description: Shark swimming from left to right

TREE_GROUP.description: Group of trees (2 x 1 tiles: TREES_1 and TREES_2); cacti in the desert, firs and penguins in the snow theme

TREE_1.description: Tree (palm, cactus, fir, depending on the theme)

TREES_1.description: Group of trees, left half (TREES_2 is the right half, see SpriteType.TREE_GROUP); a big cactus in the desert theme

TREES_2.description: Group of trees, right half (next to TREES_1); a group of cacti in the desert theme, penguins in the snow theme

ANIMAL_4.description: Animal (a boat in the beach theme)

SNOWMAN_XMAS.description: Snowman with a Christmas hat (6 variants) that melts ("melt")

FIRE.description: Pile of hay that burns: "burn" (all), or "ignite", "burning" (loop) and "burnOut"

SNOW.description: Snow clouds (4 variants) that leave snow ("snowing")

SHIP.description: Sailing ship (MS Floating Point), keeps rocking when idle
